# PlayerCharacter

**Tags:** `player`

The player-controlled character in the world. Stats are derived from equipped items, active skills, and status effects. A player's character persists across sessions; death resets only transient state.

> **Goal:** Model the minimum runtime data the server needs to authorise actions and the client needs to render the character

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `state` | enum (`alive`, `dead`, `respawning`) | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name chosen at character creation |
| `baseHp` | integer | yes | Maximum HP at current level/gear baseline |
| `currentHp` | integer | yes | Current hit points; 0 triggers the die transition |
| `baseSpeed` | decimal | yes | Movement speed in tiles per second |
| `positionX` | decimal | yes | World X coordinate (server-authoritative) |
| `positionY` | decimal | yes | World Y coordinate (elevation) |
| `positionZ` | decimal | yes | World Z coordinate (server-authoritative) |

### State machine

**Field:** `state` &nbsp; **Initial:** `alive`

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> alive
  alive --> dead : die\n[Emits a player_died event consumed by the UI, loot, and persistence systems; Inventory is locked; equipment remains visible to other players at the death location; Respawn timer begins immediately (default 10 seconds)]
  dead --> respawning : respawn\n[HP is restored to baseHp on completing the respawn transition; Player appears at their last-used bind point or the world spawn if none is set]
  respawning --> alive : spawn\n[Grants 5-second invulnerability window; movement is unrestricted immediately]
```

| `dead` | Player has been killed; inventory is locked; respawn timer running |  |
| `respawning` | Player is transitioning back to alive at their bind point |  |

## Behaviors

### `move`

Move the character through the world

**Rules:**
- Server validates the destination tile against the heightmap collision mesh
- Speed is reduced to 60% in water, 80% on rough terrain (volcanic, void)
- Movement input is rejected while the character is in the dead state

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `attack`

Initiate a combat action against a target entity

**Rules:**
- Attack request is forwarded to CombatSystem.calculateHit
- Cooldown is determined by the equipped weapon's attack speed field
- Attacks from the dead state are silently dropped by the server

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `die`

Transition to dead state on HP reaching 0

**Rules:**
- Emits a player_died event consumed by the UI, loot, and persistence systems
- Inventory is locked; equipment remains visible to other players at the death location
- Respawn timer begins immediately (default 10 seconds)

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `respawn`

Begin respawning at the player's bound respawn point

**Rules:**
- HP is restored to baseHp on completing the respawn transition
- Player appears at their last-used bind point or the world spawn if none is set

**Auth:** `maintainer`

### `spawn`

Complete respawn; character becomes interactive again

**Rules:**
- Grants 5-second invulnerability window; movement is unrestricted immediately

**Auth:** `maintainer`
